alt: It’s not too late to add to your semester. Register now for an 8 Week 2 class! Here’s how:•	Go to your myUNT portal and click on the class search function. •	In the search field enter “%.” This will return all subjects. •	On the left-hand menu under Academic Session, select Eight Week - Second to filter down to only 8 Week 2 courses. More classes are being added, so make sure to check back to see what’s available!Registration ends Oct. 8.
